prompt: A terraced hill town with switchback streets.

card.name: Switchback Terrace Town

site.text: A terraced hill town with switchback streets climbing the slope in stepped levels

style.text: Warm, lived-in hill town: stone retaining walls, timber and plaster houses, tiled roofs, lantern-lit stairs

purpose.text: A place to live and gather: a hill town with homes, trade and a seat of community on the summit

card.interpretation: You described a town built up a slope in terraces joined by zigzag streets. I read the site as a hilltop on existing hillside, the style as warm medieval stone and timber, and the purpose as a general home base. The program is a medium settlement with a hall on the summit, houses stepping down the terraces, and a few workplaces along the switchbacks.
assumptions: Size M, since none was stated
Medieval style assumed as a neutral fit for a hill town
Purpose set to a general home base
Existing hillside used rather than sculpting
